units.source_text: 像跳遠一樣朝單槓縱身一躍，結果卻「撲通」一聲，一屁股跌坐在了沙灘上。

en.t: Like doing a long jump, I threw myself toward the horizontal bar, but with a thud I ended up falling onto the sandy ground on my backside.

units.source_text: 這一次失敗全是我事先算計好的，果然引得大家捧腹大笑，我自己也苦笑著，拂去褲子上的沙子爬了起來。

en.t: This failure was entirely something I had planned in advance; just as expected, it made everyone burst out laughing, and I myself got up with a bitter smile, brushing the sand from my pants.

units.source_text: 這時，竹一不知何時已悄然來到我旁邊，捅了捅我的後背，小聲說：「故意的，故意的。」

en.t: At that moment, Takeichi had somehow quietly come up beside me, poked me in the back, and whispered, "On purpose. On purpose."

units.source_text: 我非常震驚，完全沒想到，竹一竟然識破了我假裝失敗的真相。

en.t: I was utterly shocked; I had never imagined that Takeichi would see through the truth that I had only pretended to fail.

units.source_text: 那一刻，我彷彿看見世界在一瞬間被地獄之火籠罩著，在眼前熊熊燃燒。

en.t: In that instant, it was as if I saw the whole world suddenly wrapped in the flames of hell, blazing fiercely before my eyes.

units.source_text: 我竭盡全力剋制住了險些「哇！」地大叫出聲的瘋狂。

en.t: With all my strength, I held back the madness that nearly made me cry out, "Ah!"
